description:
Cast Shifting Wall by paying {0}.
Shifting Wall enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Liliana, Dreadhorde General.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shifting Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Shifting Wall from your library.
Repeat.
